operationDefinition.description: The number of element read-and-write assignments transferring each cell (r, c) to rotated position (c, N - 1 - r) in the target matrix.

secondaryMetrics.coordinateCalculations: Evaluation of rotated column index targetCol = N - 1 - r (N^2 operations)
secondaryMetrics.replayFrames: Visualizer frames: 1 start + 1 alloc + N^2 place + 1 complete = N^2 + 3 frames

mathematicalComplexityAnalysis.asymptoticTimeComplexity: Θ(N^2) where N is matrix side length, or Θ(M) where M = N^2 is the total number of matrix elements
mathematicalComplexityAnalysis.asymptoticSpaceComplexity: Θ(N^2) for the newly allocated non-mutating rotated matrix
mathematicalComplexityAnalysis.empiricalVerification: Placements strictly equal N^2 for all tested sizes: 2^2=4, 3^2=9, 4^2=16.
